## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Stops a damage modification that was started by the [Start Damage Modification](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/start%2Bdamage%2Bmodification) action.

## Snippet

```
Stop Damage Modification(Last Damage Modification ID);
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Void</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Damage Modification_==

> ==**Damage Modification**==
> _Type: **DamageModificationId**, Default: **[Last Damage Modification ID](/wiki/articles/last+damage+modification+id)**_
> Specifies which damage modification instance to stop. This id may be last damage modification id or a variable into which last damage modification id was earlier stored.
````
